What is openai-codex-desktop?

The official ChatGPT desktop app bundled with Codex, OpenAI's agentic coding assistant. From one window you can chat with ChatGPT or hand a coding task to Codex, which can work across your local files and projects, run in cloud environments for longer jobs, and even do automatic code review. It's aimed at developers who want an agent that completes multi-step coding work rather than just answering questions.

Install openai-codex-desktop on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add openai-codex-desktop

Good to know

  • A ChatGPT account
  • A paid ChatGPT plan (Plus, Pro, Business, etc.) for meaningful Codex usage beyond the free allowance
  • Network access

Package details

Pricing
Codex usage is included (limited) in the ChatGPT Free plan; expanded usage needs Go ($8/mo), Plus ($20/mo), Pro ($100-200/mo) or Business
